name: Yukiyadoru Toki no Ma no Koto
source:
Suddenly, we are caught in the snow.
We have to take shelter from the snow for a while.
Let's pass the time by talking!

[From [url=https://p6ik.itch.io/yukiyadoru]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
突然，我们被雪困住了。
我们得暂时躲避雪。
让我们通过聊天来打发时间吧！

[来自[url=https://p6ik.itch.io/yukiyadoru]itch.io[/url]]
